title: Prepare 3EN Agent Runner v3.6 loop-fix snapshot
description: Read-only preparation for Runner v3.6. Detect the active runner process and source path, create a backup copy, calculate SHA256, and extract the exact state/finalization/retry-related source lines needed to patch the FAILED_SCRIPT/FAILED_TEST retry loop safely. No active runner file or process is modified.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $BackupRoot=Join-Path 'C:\3EN-Agent\backups\019a' $stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BackupRoot | Out-Null; Set-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-019a-current.txt' -Value $BackupRoot -Encoding UTF8; $procs=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object {$_.Name -match 'powershell|pwsh' -and $_.CommandLine -match '3en-agent-runner'}); if($procs.Count -eq 0){throw 'No active 3EN Agent Runner process found'}; $paths=@(); foreach($p in $procs){$m=[regex]::Match([string]$p.CommandLine,'(?i)(?:-File\s+)?["'']?(?<path>[A-Z]:\[^"'']*3en-agent-runner[^"'']*\.ps1)'); if($m.Success){$paths += $m.Groups['path'].Value}}; $paths=@($paths | Select-Object -Unique); if($paths.Count -eq 0){$paths=@(Get-ChildItem 'C:\3EN-Agent' -Filter '3en-agent-runner-v*.ps1' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName)}; if($paths.Count -eq 0){throw 'Active runner source path could not be resolved'}; $runner=$paths[0]; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $runner -Destination (Join-Path $BackupRoot (Split-Path $runner -Leaf)) -Force; Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $BackupRoot 'active-runner-path.txt') -Value $runner -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host ('ACTIVE_RUNNER='+$runner); Write-Host ('ACTIVE_RUNNER_SHA256='+(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $runner -Algorithm SHA256).Hash); Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$BackupRoot); Write-Host 'BACKUP_019A_READY'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:\3EN-Agent'; $b=(Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-019a-current.txt' -Raw).Trim(); $runner=(Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $b 'active-runner-path.txt') -Raw).Trim(); if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $runner)){throw 'Resolved runner path missing'}; $report=Join-Path $root 'runner-v36-prep-019a.txt'; $lines=@(Get-Content -LiteralPath $runner); $out=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; function A([string]$s){$out.Add($s); Write-Host $s}; A '=== 3EN AGENT RUNNER V3.6 PREP 019A ==='; A ('RUNNER='+$runner); A ('SHA256='+(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $runner -Algorithm SHA256).Hash); A ('LINES='+$lines.Count); A ''; A '=== VERSION / CONFIG ==='; foreach($pat in @('Runner v','TaskUrl','Poll','State','last-task','LastTask','result.json')){foreach($h in @(Select-String -LiteralPath $runner -Pattern $pat -SimpleMatch -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)){A (('{0,4}: {1}' -f $h.LineNumber,$h.Line.Trim()))}}; A ''; A '=== FINALIZE / STATUS / STATE CONTEXT ==='; $hits=@(Select-String -LiteralPath $runner -Pattern 'FINALIZE|FAILED_SCRIPT|FAILED_TEST|SUCCESS|status|state saved|Set-Content|LastTask|last-task|TaskHash|SHA256' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $nums=@(); foreach($h in $hits){for($n=[math]::Max(1,$h.LineNumber-3);$n -le [math]::Min($lines.Count,$h.LineNumber+5);$n++){$nums += $n}}; foreach($n in @($nums | Sort-Object -Unique)){A (('{0,4}: {1}' -f $n,$lines[$n-1]))}; A ''; A '=== TASK DECISION CONTEXT ==='; $hits2=@(Select-String -LiteralPath $runner -Pattern 'No new task|TASK DETECTED|LastTask|task.id|TaskId|SHA256|Read-Host|ReadKey' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $nums2=@(); foreach($h in $hits2){for($n=[math]::Max(1,$h.LineNumber-4);$n -le [math]::Min($lines.Count,$h.LineNumber+6);$n++){$nums2 += $n}}; foreach($n in @($nums2 | Sort-Object -Unique)){A (('{0,4}: {1}' -f $n,$lines[$n-1]))}; A ''; A '=== SYNTAX CHECK ==='; $tokens=$null;$errs=$null; [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($runner,[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errs) | Out-Null; A ('SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT='+@($errs).Count); foreach($e in @($errs)){A ('SYNTAX_ERROR='+$e.Message)}; A 'RUNNER_V36_PREP_019A=PASS'; $out | Set-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host ('REPORT='+$report)
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $report='C:\3EN-Agent\runner-v36-prep-019a.txt'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $report)){throw 'Runner v3.6 prep report missing'}; $c=Get-Content -LiteralPath $report -Raw; foreach($m in @('3EN AGENT RUNNER V3.6 PREP 019A','FINALIZE / STATUS / STATE CONTEXT','TASK DECISION CONTEXT','SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT=0','RUNNER_V36_PREP_019A=PASS')){if($c -notmatch [regex]::Escape($m)){throw ('Missing marker: '+$m)}}; Write-Host ('REPORT_SIZE='+(Get-Item -LiteralPath $report).Length); Write-Host 'VALIDATION_019A=PASS'
rollback: Write-Host 'READ-ONLY PREPARATION: active runner and process were not modified; no rollback required.'
